description: This file defines core logging structures and functions for the zap logging library, including Entry, EntryCaller, CheckedEntry, and related methods for logging, caller info, and hooks.

classes.name: EntryCaller
classes.description: Represents the caller of a logging function, including file, line, and function info.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a complete log message with level, timestamp, message, caller info, and stack.

classes.name: CheckedEntry
classes.description: An Entry with associated cores and hooks for controlled logging and post-processing.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the full path and line number of the caller.

methods.name: FullPath
methods.description: Returns a full path and line description of the caller.

methods.name: TrimmedPath
methods.description: Returns a package/file:line description, trimming to leaf directory and filename.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the CheckedEntry to initial state.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes the log entry to all cores, handles errors, and executes hooks.

methods.name: AddCore
methods.description: Adds a Core to the CheckedEntry for logging.

methods.name: Should
methods.description: Sets the CheckWriteAction for the CheckedEntry (deprecated).

methods.name: After
methods.description: Sets a hook to be called after the log entry is written.
